description: Your journey from adventurer to king will begin here!

title: Indomitable Spirit
description: The player will play the role of an anti-Japanese soldier. In the icy and snowy forest wilderness, relying on secret camps, villages and deep mountains, they will carry out a series of dangerous tasks and ultimately expose the conspiracy of the Kwantung Army.

title: Precognition
description: PRECOGNITION follows in the footsteps of Sam Barlow’s previous game, IMMORTALITY, combining cinematic live-action sequences with non-linear storytelling and a focus on player freedom and agency. Players take on the role of Diana, a woman who discovers she can receive visions of the future after an experimental implant is embedded into her brain.

title: Frog Telephone
description: Frog Telephone is a folklore mystery adventure game rooted in computer science concepts. You play as an amnesiac phone operator at a Tokyo travel agency, reconstructing shattered reality through the spin of a dial, exploring the terrifying truth hidden behind Gero City's mystery.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Story DLC 2 - Vincent & the Turks
Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Story DLC 1 - Sephiroth
Leng
description: A bass-drenched psychedelic FPS set in a vertical megastructure built on pirate radio and rave culture.

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Tales of the Snathi
description: The Snathi have finally broken free. Scavenge the wreckage of your enemies and claim your birthright as the true heirs of the Dread Lords.

title: Off The Grid: Bad Dream
description:
Off the Grid: Bad Dream (working title: Project Escher) is a first- and third-person psychological thriller and mystery adventure developed by Rare Castle. The game follows a man who survives a fatal car crash and begins experiencing surreal dreams connected to a plane of existence beyond space and time.

Gameplay alternates between the protagonist’s grounded real-world life and an otherworldly dream realm, where consciousness exists as light or energy within mechanical vessels. Players explore non-Euclidean environments, solve puzzles, engage in limited combat, and make narrative choices emphasizing introspection, moral decision-making, and emotional healing over traditional horror.

Featuring cinematic storytelling, dialogue-driven encounters, and visually distinct worlds inspired by impossible geometry and classical art, Off the Grid: Bad Dream blends mystery, philosophy, and emotional depth into a story-driven experience focused on self-discovery and healing rather than fear.

title: Surangama
description: Unravel the truth and secrets which bind Tse Li Li to her forgotten past. Battle through hordes of relentless malformed souls and solve intricate puzzles in this Survival Horror X Character Action mashup set in a neon soaked Diyu, the Chinese-Buddhist vision of Hell, inspired by Kowloon Walled City.

title: Amira
description: Amira: A story driven adventure about a girl born in a middle eastern-fantasy world who finds by chance that her life is written and predetermined as she was helping her family, thus she fights for acceptance, love and writing her own life.

title: Abdication
description: Fight through this corrupted monarchy in order to take the king's power and the crown, and destroy it to free the kingdom, all with a yoyo. It's too powerful to let anyone else wield it, so protect it at all costs!

title: Waveling Island
description: Waveling Island is a Creature-Collecting Sim that takes place on a beautiful, hand-drawn pixelart island full of mysterious creatures called Wavelings. Catch, train and battle these creatures in order to complete quests, gather materials, and make a stake in this new tropical home of yours.

title: Magenta Down
description: You and your crew have crashed and are now scattered across the surface of a harsh, remote exoplanet. With limited supplies and surrounded by hostile terrain, can you find your crew and escape?

title: Clickomorph
description: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

title: Odd Shop
description: Manage a haunted pawn shop in this cozy horror game. Cursed items are your most popular wares, but keeping them all under one roof can have deadly consequences. Upgrade and maintain the shop to build a retail reputation that cannot be denied...or make your money and get out before it’s too late.

title: Demiourgos
description: A first-person horror. A man wakes up at 3 AM and the sea starts calling. Every person and every animal has a line of destiny. Can you change them before the great end?

title: Afterzero: The Last Drive
description: Drive and survive through a frozen post-industrial wasteland. Gear up your vehicle with different tools to tackle hostile threats, while scavenging for resources. Lead a small survivor camp while discovering the truth about what happened.

title: Encryption
description: Encryption is a cinematic first-person psychological horror adventure set during a climate catastrophe burning through southern Italy. A father searches for his missing daughter in Matera, one of the oldest inhabited places on Earth, now evacuated, while something awaits in the darkness below.

title: Malsort
description: Malsort is an action MMO inspired by the classic ARPGs. A cursed world of ash and burning thrones, shared with every hero who dares. Hunt in parties, craft from what you slay, sell your finds at your own stall, and raid the world bosses to loot ancient relics.

title: Blooming Solitude: Priestess of Hanafuda
description: Hanafuda × Roguelite × Action! Explore dungeons, collect Hanafuda cards, and grow stronger as a Miko. Battle enemies with the power of your cards, then face powerful bosses in Hanafuda battles. Form winning hands and unleash devastating attacks!

title: Overtime at Holiday's
description: Overtime at Holiday's is a point-and-click adventure game. Cleaners Bill and Jules take a weekend job cleaning Max Holiday's mansion, but when they find Max dead in his pool they become trapped in an endless loop of overtime, forced to move his body around the mansion while avoiding security and the other guests. Players look at items, pick them up, use them and talk to characters to solve puzzles and find out how to escape the time loop.

title: Force Typhoon
description: Experience the chaos and intensity of high-speed combat in this atmospheric sci-fi vertical Shoot ’Em Up, rendered in full 3D. Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies as you unleash your arsenal to defend your home against overwhelming odds!

title: Echo Sequence
description: An isometric, top-down roguelite shooter where your deaths are your squad. Die, and your last life fights on as an Echo, repeating every move and every shot. Die again and there are two. Plan across loops, split the work between your past selves, and clear each level together.

title: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot
description: The year is 1907, set in a small, nearly abandoned town. Two murders within three days will shatter the peaceful life of recent years. A point-and-click adventure game where you play as both the killer and the detective, alternating each day, experiencing the story from both perspectives.

title: Cosmic Dominion
description: Cosmic Dominion is a 2D space combat and real-time strategy game. The player pilots a flagship in direct ship-to-ship combat while expanding and defending a territory of planets across a galaxy. Each planet runs its own economy: it mines ore, builds infrastructure and defences, recruits crew from its population, fields a garrison of ships and pays its holder a share of its income. Planets can be won by investment, by breaching their defences and landing a boarding party, or by destroying them and settling the ruins. Rival AI factions led by commanders play under the same economic rules as the player, mining, trading, colonising and going to war. The game features weapons with distinct damage classes and upgrade tracks, ship and planet modules, periodic invasions by an Insectoid swarm hostile to every faction, and configurable galaxies with up to eight player slots, teams, map sizes, wraparound edges, difficulty settings and shareable seeds.

title: Boba Bears
description: Run a cozy boba shop for bears, discover hidden drink and topping combos, decorate your space, prep ingredients through playful minigames, and meet new bear customers at your own pace. No timers, no pressure, just sweet drinks, curious experiments, and soft village moments.

title: The Escapists 3
description: Plan ridiculous prison breaks, outsmart the guards and escape your way in The Escapists 3. Craft, sneak, fight and improvise through a new 3D prison sandbox, alone or with friends. Just remember to make roll call.

title: Little Prince Tyger
description: Combine archery and simulated physics in single screen levels in this violent action roguelike. By order of the Queen, hunt and do not question it.

title: Gods with Badges
description: Patrol the streets of Scarhelm. Decide the fate of your fellow citizens. Take down criminals in brutal turn-based combat. You are a god with a badge, and when you turn on your bodycam, the only thing you answer to is your conscience, and your fellow officers.

title: Jiaohun
description: Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And now, a message from Fairy Town's end...

title: His Last Film
description: What happened during the filming? Stan doesn't remember. Explore the decaying depths of an abandoned subway station, piece together a fragmented reality, and discover the horrifying truth behind his last film. Some memories are better left unmade.

title: Intercept Course
description: Intercept Course is a tactical space auto battler where you command a starship caught in a temporal rift while chasing a tech thief. Recruit a crew, survive with limited resources, and modify your starship to face rival factions stuck in their own conflicts across every corner of the multiverse.

title: Charnel
description: Diablo, but with guns. Descend into the crypts, where darkness reigns, the dead linger, and your light only reaches so far. In this real-time ASCII roguelike you'll uncover an arsenal of weapons, battle hordes of the damned, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth, with one life to reach the bottom.

title: Garden Hustle
description: Start your own gardening service in a charming neighborhood! Take on relaxing jobs like mowing lawns, planting flowers, blowing leaves, cleaning backyard pools, and more with bite-sized mini-games. Earn money to upgrade your tools, unlock plants, and decorate your own garden between jobs!

title: Dark Pals: The 2nd Floor
description: The next chapter of the mascot horror game Dark Pals: The 1st Floor is set in the abandoned depths of UpWard. Armed with your Ink Blaster, you solve puzzles and navigate encounters with new creatures, including the Devourer, while uncovering the mystery of your connection to UpWard and the Dark Pals.

title: Bird Roll 64
description: This recovered copy of a lost 3D ball-rolling platformer from the 90s appears to have been created by eldritch forces from out of this world. Would you be able to find all its secrets and escape its surreal spaces?

title: Sundae Drive
description: Hit the road in your very own ice cream truck! Explore a cute neighborhood, park in the perfect spot, and serve adorable animal customers their dream sundaes. Scoop, drizzle, and top to perfection. Upgrade your cute truck, restock supplies, and create your own ice cream flavors!

title: Tabletop Inc.
description: Start a tabletop game company in your bedroom workshop! Develop unique genres and themes, assemble the game boxes yourself, pay your bills, hire your friends, upgrade your workshop, and design even better games in this cozy management tycoon.

title: Whistle Willie
description: A Steamboat Willie-inspired first-person, open-world horror game. Navigate a haunting world by boat, upgrade your vessel, and arm yourself to survive. Uncover the chilling secrets needed to free the inhabitants from Willies relentless attacks.

title: Moonlight
description: Moonlight is a survival crafting game set in a dynamic alien world that shifts around you. Change the landscape of a beautiful, deadly, procedurally-generated 2D world by growing food, encountering strange creatures and building powerful machines that will help you escape this awful place... maybe.

title: I Am Plague
description: I Am Plague is a dark fantasy incremental roguelite in which players build a rat horde to climb an underground fortress. Combat is automatic, with outcomes determined by mutations, abilities, and their synergies. Players select mutations, visit shops, and choose branching routes through dungeon floors and text-based events. Flesh and skulls gathered during runs fund permanent upgrades and unlock new mutations at the Tree of Flesh and Tree of Bones. The full game is planned to include over 200 floors, more than 50 mutations across several rarity tiers, and increasingly dangerous enemies and bosses.

title: Impossible Machine
description: Impossible Machine is a 2.5D graphic adventure where you explore, talk, and build solutions while solving a mystery. No minigames, but plenty of terrible jokes. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Arctic Shop Simulator
description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

title: System Intruder
description: Dive into the atmospheric dread of classic 3D games. Unravel the dark secrets of the ASGARD-04 research complex in this gripping, narrative-driven retro-cyberpunk survival horror.

title: The Other Side of the Wall
description:
This is the story of Julian Reed, a 13-year old boy attending Saint Maximus the Confessor Catholic School in the early 1980s. Saint Maximus is an all-boys boarding school that shares a wall with another institution for "troubled cases" called Cedar Tree House. Cedar Tree House is shrouded in mystery, as discussing it is frowned upon by the Benedictine monks who make up most of the teaching staff at Julian's school. There is no contact between the two institutions, at least not as far as the students are concerned.

It's late August, the semester has not even started, and only a few students and faculty members are present when Julian discovers a tiny hole in an isolated corner of the wall separating Saint Maximus from Cedar Tree House. The hole is just big enough for him to see a pair of blue eyes. They belong to a girl who soon becomes his closest confidante.

The opportunity to spend time with a girl, albeit separated by a wall, is a welcome distraction from Julian's routine, but it will not be the only one. One boring morning, during class, he notices that one of his classmates is missing from his usual desk. When Julian asks about him, he is shocked to discover that nobody acknowledges that the student ever existed.

The Other Side of the Wall is more than a whodunit game. It's a coming-of-age story of a boy who stumbles upon a mystery and finds himself in over his head. A story about friendship, curiosity, and the unsettling feeling that something is terribly wrong.

The Other Side of the Wall is a traditional 3rd person point & click adventure game. This is a game for people who enjoy being challenged with (mostly inventory based) puzzles and being rewarded for paying close attention to subtle clues.

title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2
description: Build a roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?

title: BrokenLore: Miki-chan
description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese high school. Meet Miki-chan, your personal virtual assistant, and survive a nightmare where jealousy and obsession distort reality.

title: The Crossing
description: Explore a world inspired by the landscapes of the Gobi Desert behind the wheel of a rally car. Find your way through vast steppes and seas of dunes, and uncover Misheel’s story and the reasons behind her return to the land of her childhood.

title: Swaggerfall
description: Swaggerfall is a first-person open world fantasy RPG that plays in the terminal. The graphics are ascii based and limited to what the command line offers. Playable with keyboard or gamepad.

title: The Emperor Penguin Incident
description: "All Antarctic researchers dead. Cause of death: Emperor Penguin attack?" Log into the isolated 'Amundsen-4' server. Extract and combine [keywords] from fragmented emails, chats, and logs to uncover the truth behind the bizarre disaster.

title: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
description: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

title: The Word
description: The Word is a Christian word game that recounts the life of Jesus through more than 600 cryptogram puzzles based on Gospel verses. Decode each passage using a revealed word as a clue, adjust the difficulty and play settings, and choose from several Bible translations. Solving puzzles also unlocks traditional artwork depicting moments from Jesus’s life.

title: Huemon
description: Discover and collect Huemon, and lead your full team into tactical turn-based battles. Journey through a world powered by color, experiment with team compositions, positioning, and synergies to overcome every challenge.

title: Hino
description: Hino, a girl with a red ribbon, and the white Monimoni Skeleton journey through a world of darkness in this 2D dark fantasy game. Having lost her memory, Hino seeks a safe haven in a land overrun by monsters, uncovering the truth of the dark world as she travels.

title: Acorn: Seed of Resistance
description: Exploration, party building, and against-all-odds heroism in 15-minute roguelike adventures. Shape your rodent companions into a formidable fighting force and unleash them in brutal auto battles to retake your woodland home.

title: In Vino Veritas
description: Explore a desecrated cathedral to find your missing wife in this psychological horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind the Elohim, solve ancient puzzles, and survive a chilling journey where faith and reality collide. The Bible was mistranslated; the truth is much darker

title: Faraway Galaxy
description: Faraway Galaxy is a card-based roguelite about a battle-hardened space wolf in a bizarre galaxy, focused on short, intense tactical battles and meaningful decision-making. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!

title: Giantess Naval Defense
description: Giantess Naval Defense is a “Giant Girl vs. Kaiju Naval Artillery Defense Game” where you control Orca, the only giant beast humanity can rely on, and fight back against hordes of invading kaiju with devastating naval gunfire.

title: Rose of Dragontail
description: Kick tail with tail! Enjoy blazing-fast beat-em-up action as Rose, the scrappy fishing village girl turned half-dragon hero. Kick, slam, tail slap, tackle, pile drive, spit fire, and throw whatever and whoever you get your claws on to a groovy surf rock soundtrack.

title: No One Will Miss Me
description: An existential horror visual novel. Play as a voice inside a troubled mind. Identify her cognitive distortions, shift her perspective, and win the debate that decides whether she lives or dies.

title: Love Alt Delete
description: Date. Design. Destroy. A psychological chat simulator between you and two digital personalities who desperately want to be people. Type keywords to control them, uncover their secrets, and choose their fates.

title: Backtrace: Mechanisms for Forgetting
description: Backtrace is a yuri mystery and puzzle game set inside a retro computer. Log on night after night to uncover a story of internet exploits and unexpected friendships with a crew of 80s hackers. Solve 2D grid-based puzzles to piece together the mystery.

title: Weiß Schwarz Online
description: Battle with cards from your favorite titles! Weiss Schwarz, the world's No. 1 card game by number of participating titles, is now a video game! With a full tutorial and online battles, players of all skill levels, from beginners to experts, can enjoy the game.

title: Kigurumi Hearts
description: Interrogate the suspect. Survive the shift. Interrogation survival horror about exploration of inability to become, and rotting with it.

title: Another Medium
description: Another Medium is a non-linear adventure featuring a mix of sci-fi, horror, drama, and thriller. Explore the world, make decisions, create your psychological profile, remain a puppet in the hands of outside forces, or break the control, even if the price turns out to be too high.

title: Bleach & Blood
description: Bleach & Blood is a retro slasher horror game about surviving the night shift at a small-town laundromat while a killer stalks the streets.

title: Agent Skunk: Stink Ops
description:
Step into the paws of the world’s stealthiest operative, a highly trained skunk agent on a mission to infiltrate, sabotage, and extract without ever being seen. Adorable on the outside, unstoppable in the field.

In this dynamic stealth-action adventure, you’ll crawl through shadows, leap across rooftops, and sabotage alien technology using a unique arsenal of spy tools. Set traps, deploy gas bombs, or vanish entirely with invisibility mode; every mission can be approached your way.

title: Wednesday 13th
description:
Midnight strikes.
The gates slam shut.
The manor begins to breathe… and hunt.

You are Vanessa Mort — the lost soul trapped inside the haunted Institute on Wednesday the 13th, the cursed night when walls whisper, shadows stalk, and your darkest fears take shape. Every creak in the dark could be a jump scare. Every corridor could be your last.

title: 3AM Anomaly Store
description:
Step into the shoes of a clerk in 3AM ANOMALY STORE: Night Shift Horror, a tense first-person horror simulation where running a quiet roadside convenience store is only the beginning. This isn't your average neighborhood market. While you keep the shelves stocked, answer calls, and serve customers, a dark supernatural secret lurks just out of sight.
Behind the backroom door, a shimmering portal awaits. Every night, you must feed an otherworldly creature with specific visitors - not true human beings, but entities that look like ordinary people. You must solve the mystery of who belongs and who is an anomaly before they leave your sight.

title: Cryptwake
description: Cryptwake is a fast-paced first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Fight through ever-changing floors, uncover strange secrets, wield powerful weapons, build devastating synergies, and survive the horrors that stalk the dungeon.

title: Marked for Mayhem
description: Enter a shattered world where dimensions collide in this competitive 4-player action dungeon runner. Defeat and leverage diverse bosses, win chaotic challenges, master your build around unique weapons, and sabotage your rivals to take the top spot. The mission is shared. The glory isn't.

title: Dust Till Dawn
description: A retro-paranormal powerwash simulator, where you're a maid restoring a quiet rural Japanese village. Dust, mop, squeegee to your heart's content...but don't stay too late!

title: Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga
description: Lufia and its sequel, Lufia II, return! In a love letter to JRPG fans, these two dramatic tales of love and loss, which moved countless players to tears, are back!

title: Beltfed
description: You are a rogue AI with one directive: Automate death. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In Beltfed, the factory is your weapon.

title: Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity
description: "Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity" is a Time-loop horror RTA stealth action adventure Game, Seira steps into the school at midnight to which seven mysteries and the brutal curse of the cursed doll, Aya await her there, Break free from this inescapable loop of death and escape this night of terror.

title: Bad House
description: Welcome to your new home. The previous tenant left some things. You can have them, but there's just one condition: don't go into the basement. Explore the many rooms of a mysterious basement in Bad House, an auto-battler dungeon crawler.

title: You Are Family
description: You’re looking to disconnect in a secluded country house. A family welcomes you in. Soon, you’ll discover that feeling at home here… may be more real than you imagine.

title: Scholar Adventure: Lost Night
description: An ancient prophecy is about to awaken. Guided by a mysterious artifact, William ventures into Azig, where a secret society, ancient temples, and opposing forces await, trapped beneath the eternal sun. Uncover the truth that could change the fate of these lands.

title: Faraday Blues
description: Faraday Blues is a surreal science fiction adventure about a daughter searching for parents who don't know she exists. Play as Lina, a mysterious girl who awakens in a place she doesn't understand. An old computer introduces her to a strange game table filled with cards. Two of them bear the faces of her parents. However, they have no idea who she is. Worse still: their lives are already marked by tragedy.

title: Mezanine
description: Mezanine is both a literal and figurative small scale sandbox builder where you can construct and recolor your own creations to compliment its gigantic environment.

title: Sonar
description: Sonar is a survival-horror game set on an abandoned alien planet. Explore vast, dark caves using sonar pulses that briefly reveal the world around you. Research unknown species by taking photographs, recording audio, and collecting samples. Upgrade your equipment and survive deeper explorations.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong Remaster
description: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong arrives as a mahjong game! Harness your mahjong skills to face the tragedy! Featuring an original scenario supervised by original creator Ryukishi07 and animated cutscenes with over 7,000 frames! This is the ultimate Hinamizawa mahjong experience!

title: Everything Must Fit!
description: In this puzzle game, transform, combine, and break items to arrange them to fit the grid. No matter what, everything MUST fit!

title: Pirate Troops
description: Follow the journey of Sammy Shortlegs in this fun yet mysterious tale! Uncover the whereabouts of powerful pirate relics lost to time, and confront the terrifying Shadowbeard.

title: Chibits: The King's Tomb
description: Collect, train, and battle Chibits in a fast-paced roguelike card game. Manage your creatures between runs, master tactical combat, and travel through a branching galaxy where every choice shapes your destiny.

title: Donny Donut: Stardust
description: Welcome to the world of Donny Donut, a world full of colors and sweets! This time, Donny will travel through many planets and galaxies to save the whole universe from the evil Burger King!

title: This Is Not For You
description: After a ghost ship crashes into an isolated lighthouse, Ulysses’ memories come back to trap him in an endless, twisting maze full of riddles, blood, and magic. Draw your own map, and find a way to burn it all down.

title: Pinbomb
description: The Pinball Roguelike! Pinbomb traps you in a room with a pinball machine hungry for higher and higher scores. Buy new parts to upgrade it, build wild synergies to feed the machine, and send your score through the roof. Oh, and there's a bomb strapped to it, so score big or go boom!

title: Professor Layton and the Curious Village Remake
Escape Path
description: Navigate complex mazes using your logic and avoiding enemies to rebuild the protective crystal. A hand-drawn puzzle-game combining action and problem-solving, where every mistake can be fatal! Ready to take on the challenge and find the pieces before it's too late?

title: Hoshin Engi Re:surrection
description: Wield mythic treasures, ride spirit beasts, and hack and slash through ever-shifting dungeons in an all-new roguelite steeped in Chinese myth, based on Ryu Fujisaki's Weekly Shonen Jump manga. A new hero, a new story, thirty years on.

title: Next: The Portopia Serial Murder Case
description: The legendary "The Portopia Serial Murder Case" is reborn! Under the executive direction of Yuji Horii comes an all-new entry featuring five brand-new investigation files. Set in 1980s Kobe, conduct your investigation alongside a new cast of characters and uncover the secrets hidden behind the case.

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
description: Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. Explore the rear palace and capital to gather evidence and question witnesses, then assemble what you've learned into theories and deductions to solve thrilling mysteries in this sprawling adventure game.

title: Metal Slug Ultimate Collection
description:
Metal Slug Ultimate Collection is a compilation of the entire Metal Slug series, including mainline entries, handheld titles, and the rare Location Test Version. It features quality-of-life improvements like Quick Save and Rewind, plus new modes such as Combat School and online leaderboards for added replayability.

Included Titles:

Metal Slug 1996)
Metal Slug 2 (1998)
Metal Slug X (1999)
Metal Slug 3 (2000)
Metal Slug 4 (2002)
Metal Slug 5 (2003)
Metal Slug Advance (2004)
Metal Slug 6 (2006)
Metal Slug 7 (2008)
The legendary Metal Slug Location Test Version (Never officially released)

title: Ondeh Ondeh Kaya's Tasty Tale
description: Join Kaya on her quest to become a Worldbuilder in this heartwarming puzzle action-adventure. Explore the whimsical world of Selera, inspired by the rich cultures of Southeast Asia, where rhythm powers exploration, puzzles, and combat in a heartfelt tale of family, courage, and self-discovery.

title: Onyx: The Dark Grip
description: Set in an isolated town trapped in an endless winter, ONYX: The Dark Grip challenges players to survive through two deeply intertwined roles. As The Vessel, players explore a bleak, frozen world, fight for survival, manage scarce resources and confront the dangers hiding within the town and beneath its snow. But human strength can only go so far. When The Vessel cannot survive alone, players become The God, reaching directly into his world to manipulate reality, protect their host and change what happens beyond the limits of an ordinary human being. Survival depends on knowing when to act as The Vessel and when to intervene as The God.

title: Wolf of The Desert
description: Infiltrate Qamaria tower. Sneak through shadows, observe your surroundings. Gather ability chips to destroy and hack security devices, vanish, teleport past enemies, outsmart them using clones. Combine and upgrade ability chips for the ultimate loadout and bring down a corporate empire

title: Alumbra
description: Alumbra is a suspenseful and surreal Metroidvania. Play as Vince, a frightened child trapped in a nightmare shaped by his fears and imagination. Armed with a lantern, master the light, explore haunting dreamscapes, overcome terrifying creatures, and face your fears to wake up.

title: Spirit of Diwata
description: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

title: Mana Alchemy
description: An open-world bullet heaven RPG. Explore a cursed island, forge spells via alchemy, and arrange them in your grimoire like a puzzle. Mow down monster hordes and hunt your 7 ruling sisters. Your final choice—execute or forgive them—determines the ending of this dark fantasy.

title: Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients
description: Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients is a turn-based RPG set in the Tang Dynasty. As amnesiac Tianji Guard Shangguan Shuo, investigate the mysterious Xuanxin Order and uncover the truth of your past—only to discover your fate may be deeply tied to the Order.

title: The Stalked 4
description: Desperate for work, 27-year-old George signs up for the remote lighthouse job. What starts as beautiful and peaceful scenery slowly turns unsettling day by day. Is it just your mind playing tricks on you? Or is someone else here...?

title: The Miracle Of San Martin
description:
A survival horror experience that mixes classic and modern elements, a story where faith meets fear.

Explore San Martín, a remote hispanic town where a missing girl, a pit in the outskirts, whispered miracles, unspeakable sins, and buried horrors, challenge everything a Priest believes.

title: Rummy Attack
description: "Rummy Attack" is a unique Roguelite Card Battler based on Rummy rules! Place cards on the field to create "Melds" (Sets or Runs) to unleash skills. Build your deck and overcome physical gimmicks like ground fissures to defeat the final boss. Choose between Tactical Move or High-Speed Time Mode!

title: The End of Allegoria
description: A turn-based tactical RPG where your choices determine the fate of the world. Traverse a world that changes as you explore it, find new companions, and combine different class skills by mastering a multitude of equipment.

title: Lancelot: The Silver Knight
description: Experience the legends of Lancelot: The Silver Knight, as he sets out on a quest to reclaim his title as a knight. A quirky top-down action-adventure game set in an mystical Brittany filled with enigmatic dungeons, legendary monsters and chickens?

title: SinsKiller
description:
SinsKiller is an action arcade shooter where you play as a fallen mage in a Dante's inspired Hell. You get to use your magic powers to obliterate hordes of enemies and bullet-hell bosses.

In SinsKiller you get a mix of bullet-hell and survivors like gameplay with no RNG, where movement, aim and timing matter most. You can choose from different magic elements to fit your playstyle then equip other items to create a build that feels truly yours. Each circle is inspired by the literary classis Divine Comedy while story itself draws inspiration from another Italian classic Jerusalem Delivered.

title: Heartreasure: Recolor the World
description: “This world was never meant to be so blank!” Help Mary, a fairy Mendako who can’t remember her precious friend, as you find hidden hearts to bring color back to the world! A point-and-click hidden object adventure…Wait, why did the world disappear in the first place?

title: Battle of the Kyoshin
description: A miko gal and a Kyoshin go head-to-head with an enemy Kyoshin! Power up your Kyoshin as you fight, and take them down! Finish them with a trump-card Kamiwaza!

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Story Expansion Pass
description: Final Fantasy VII Revelation's Story Expansion Pass. This product includes Accessory: Reclaimant Choker & Survival Set, Story DLC 1: Sephiroth, and Story DLC 2: Vincent & the Turks.

title: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator
description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator on an abandoned Hollywood studio. Fantasy epics, sitcoms, sci-fi blockbusters: their props ended up here. Sort it all, ship boxed orders to film sets and beyond, sell the rest, and resurrect the old animatronics to help.

title: CONQ: Crown of No Quarter
description: You were promised the heavens, but found only eternal purgatory -- unable to escape, unable to truly die. Gather your forces across sea and land, show no mercy, and give your enemies no quarter. It's time to bleed again.

title: Digimon Story Time Stranger: A Hero's Eternal Legacy
The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes
description:
Lurk in the shadows and hunt the shadows.
The Eminence in Shadow comes to home consoles for the first time!
Challenge the powerful opponents that stand in your way in this roguelite action game.

title: Uncanyon
description: Uncanyon is a puzzle-first adventure that drops you into a forgotten world, tucked into the seam between unparallel realities.

title: Maneater 2
description: The splash-hit ShaRkPG returns in Maneater 2! Eat, explore, and evolve as you try to escape an invite-only preview event for Neptune’s Kingdom — an ultra-luxury seaside theme park destined for disaster, where YOU are that disaster.

title: Churrasco
description: Be the family BBQ master and try to grill in peace while your chaotic relatives turn everything upside down. Manage the grill, handle food orders, complete quests, and capture memories.

title: Captive Love Melty Holic
description: Ruito, a popular underground idol, is suddenly kidnapped and confined in an unfamiliar abandoned building. Blocked by tricky traps and relentlessly pursued by obsessive stans—can Ruito safely escape this building of madness...?

title: Fedanheim
description: A first-person psychological horror set in a plant that runs on human flesh. Lose limbs, scavenge scrap, and craft prostheses at the workbench to open the way forward. Every replacement makes your steps louder, and something in the corridors hears everything. You cannot fight it. Run and hide.

title: Silk & Sorrow
description: Two children stumble into a hidden world where all the unwanted from humanity ends up to find new purpose. Together, they must explore a haunting, hand-drawn landscape, survive its twisted horrors, and uncover the origins of the Chrysalis

title: Shrine Labyrinth
description: A 1–4 player co-op Japanese horror game. Beyond the torii gate lies an otherworldly labyrinth whose layout changes randomly. Work together to escape as you run from, hide from, and sometimes confront terrifying supernatural entities!

title: My Friend, Dysentery
description: A darkly comedic "horribly realistic fantasy travel simulator" survival adventure roguelike inspired by Oregon Trail. Journey to the Promised Land to kill a dragon! Fight monsters, manage supplies & disasters, and learn that fantasy journeys are nothing heroic like the films, but cripplingly brutal.

title: Hound Riders
description: A western post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where cards are bullets. Build your ammo, chain blood-magic combos, and target enemy aim spots in tactical turn-based duels. Explore a cursed wasteland in a nonlinear map where every route, shot, and choice matters.

title: Super Bloom
description: Grab your watering can, find some seeds and make the desert around you bloom. - No combat, no death, no timer. Just you and your garden.

title: Likvar: Zoya
description: You are assigned to Zoya, a candidate with 30 days to become a Likvar—a superpowered field operative. Manage her condition, send her on dangerous missions, and report or alter the results. Your choices shape her performance, trust, and future.

title: Retrobot
description: The year is 2109, and Retrobots is the world's most chaotic sport. Select your Retrobot, customize and tune it to perfection, and enter the battle. Smash, slam, launch, and destroy your opponents in arenas across the world. Are you ready to kick some bot?

title: Last Wail of the Sea King
description: Explore the body of a dying sea beast in this first-person RPG with JRPG-inspired turn-based combat. Recruit bizarre companions, battle mutated creatures and uncover the secrets of the Sea King.

title: Yttrium X
description: Zellia Mots goes awol and steals yttrium X the Plutocracy of Yeoman's secret Mech in this PvE mech brawler!

title: Escape the Exomoon
description: Escape the Exomoon is a narrative driven cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

title: Outblight
description: "Nothing down there is what the stories say." A turn-based clash roguelite where you pit your moves against the enemy's, slot against slot and the stronger strike breaks through. Kirs takes the contracts nobody else will. The legends are silent about the abyss, so Kirs goes down to ask in person.

title: Grampage: Life at 67
description: Your retirement isn't going to fund itself! Pension not cutting it? No problem. Grab up to three fellow retirees, break into houses, and steal your way to the retirement you deserve. Work together when you have to - but remember: only one of you gets to retire!

title: Vaewolf
description: Half-werewolf, half-vampire… all vengeance. Unleash your relentless wrath in a brutal, ceaseless quest for revenge in a bold Hack and Slash power fantasy set in the untamed English North.

title: Rise of the Spellbaker
description: In Rise of the Spellbaker, a charming hand-crafted, fairy-tale inspired Action-Adventure, one Witch finds herself to be the sole survivor of an unknown plague. With no-one but your loyal Cat Familiar by your side, set forth into the corrupted land.

title: Rogue Fortune
description: Fast-paced action roguelite where greed meets relentless combat, demanding ever stronger builds and sacrifices. Cut through hordes of monsters, arrange Relics into devastating arcane synergies, and gamble your newfound fortune for the strength to escape a temple determined to take it all back.

title: Black Walls
description: Explore a silent, impossible world of puzzles and obstacles. Make symbolic choices whose consequences may not be clear, your decisions shape your ending. Choose Chill Mode for a calm, mysterious journey with nothing hunting you, or Horror Mode for fear, danger, and something that wants you dead.

title: Cutout
description: Dismember your enemies and steal their limbs to gain new powers in this side-scrolling action horror game set in a grim, handcrafted fairy tale world made of paper. Rebuild Lena, child of the forest, and shape who she becomes through the choices you make.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern
description: Tired of going on adventures? Build and run the finest tavern in the coziest corner of the Dungeons & Dragons universe. Let heroes face danger, while you turn their tales into your fortune. Every legend needs a long rest.

title: Last Ditch Effort
description: Enter a grimdark world consumed by endless war and join Igor on a desperate mission in Last-Ditch Effort, a pixel-art character-action game featuring fast-paced combat, handcrafted animation and stylized comic-book storytelling.

title: Kingdom III: Rising Realms
description: Protect your crown! Kingdom returns in an all-new micro-strategy and tower defense game set in a shattered realm. Embark on an atmospheric adventure across lands of legend to build a lasting legacy and challenge the empowered Greed threat.

title: Police Simulator
description: The latest entry in the Police Simulator franchise lets you build your career in Faremont City. Take on over 50 missions and callouts, patrol with a K9 partner, drive specialized police vehicles, and play solo or with a friend.

title: Sweetheart
description: Survive the breakup with your high school sweetheart of 15 years. Escape her Hollywood mansion where fame, dysfunction, and the fantasy of everlasting love has mutated your lifelong partner into a monster.

title: The Creature Mafia
description: Battle creatures, survive the mob, and explore the city prohibition forgot! An action RPG + creature collector set in 1926 Kansas City, The Creature Mafia mixes a realistic world with cartoonish creature combat. Your creatures’ lives are in your hands - can you prevail against the mob?

title: Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms
description: Greak 2 is a hand-drawn co-op metroidvania adventure. After fleeing their invaded world, siblings Greak and Adara find themselves in the hostile lands of Synoraz. Split in parallel dimensions, they must work together to save the last Storm egg before the ancient species is lost forever

title: Chosen By Odin
description: Hunt the cults of Ragnarök across epic Norse realms in this 1-3 player co-op action game. Wield Godly powers, roll dice to shape mighty builds with your friends, and escape as overwhelming hordes close in. Return to Valhalla, grow stronger, and rewrite the saga.

title: Nostra
description: A story-driven dark fantasy JRPG with tactical party-based combat, built by a solo developer with external artists and musicians. Three kingdoms hold an uneasy peace while something older stirs beneath it. Leave your village and lead a party into a world of fragile beauty and gathering shadow.

title: Conquista: Tide of Wills
description: Conquista a strategy game that blends colony sim w/ 4X gameplay. Build thriving cities and lead your nation to dominance. With living units who work, build relationships, and pursue ambitions of their own, you must respond to their desires. The seeds of history may be sown through one's dreams.

title: Grandma's Guide to the Grand Outside
description: Grandma calls for aid! Well she wants a visit, but she lives in the middle of nowhere. Pack wisely, step into the wilderness, and see if you can reach her!

title: Vivid
description: Be a plant in this cozy, narrative-driven plant survival simulation about nature, responsibility, and interconnected systems. You will grow procedurally over time, explore evolving environments, and shape a fragile ecosystem through meaningful choices.

title: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake
description: Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions, faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. Explore a vibrant fantasy world and lead mighty heroes in epic battles.

title: LEGO Skylines
description: Build what only you can in LEGO Skylines. In this cozy, customizable city-builder, your choices bring a living, breathing metropolis to life. Go big or obsess over the details. No instructions. Unlimited space. And there’s just one rule. Make it yours.

title: Exterminauts
description: Exterminauts is a co-op third-person PvE shooter using weaponized power tools and mad-science gadgets to exterminate alien pests. Take on MegaCorp contracts amid energy supremacy clashes, while aliens' thirst for Polymorphic Plasma disrupts plans. Punch In. Clean Up. Get Paid.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow 6 Tactics
description: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a turn-based tactical game set in the R6 universe. Command operator squads in tense battles, execute synchronized breaches, exploit destruction, and unravel a conspiracy.

title: Age Twisters
description: Age Twisters is a 2-player co-op narrative adventure game that allows you to send a free invite to friends via the Friend’s Pass. Play as a grandfather and granddaughter to solve puzzles by freely changing your age and reveal the dark secrets hidden beneath a facade of lies.

title: Humankind II
description: Build a civilization that spans the ages in this historical turn-based strategy game. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history.

title: Murals
description: These are not the tales you were told. Express yourself through stylized combat in the hand-painted worlds of Murals, a twisted isometric action-adventure where fairytales have gone spectacularly wrong.

title: Acornia: Mirror Worlds
description: Acornia: Mirror Worlds is a bake-and-brawl management adventure game! Run your shop in one dimension, fight angry spirits in the other. Your special skill? Stuffing your bottomless cheek pouches with treats - to plate up or shoot up enemies!

title: Worms Galactic Tactics
description: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

title: Stories Once Told: Echoes of Valor
description: Cut your way through dark dungeons and solve riddles and puzzles, all from a first-person perspective. Choose your hero, master the tactical combat system, and face merciless bosses in solo mode or co-op.

title: Lovers Die
description:
Beat the Devil at his own dice game. Get out of Hell with Romeo.

Upgrade your dice, hit target scores, unlock new story branches and see where your choices take you. Inspired by Shakespeare, Dante and Baz Lurhman, alongside games like Yahtzee, Lovers Die starts with Juliet waking up in purgatory with no way out, a handful of dice, and one thing she knows for sure: Romeo got there first.

To find him, she has to play her way through Hell, making deals, taking risks and figuring out what she's willing to sacrifice for redemption. Wagers, conversations and questions all give you choices. Some open new paths. Some close them. Some have consequences you won't see coming.

title: Mica King
description: Mica King is an original top down action adventure game. Travel as an adventurer of variety skills to the once great and magical kingdom of Virrdale. Uncover the power of Mica and face the dark forces behind the bitter downfall of the king.

title: Medium Rare
description: Medium Rare is a turn-based survival dungeon crawler set in a post-apocalyptic Pacific Northwest where cannibalism has been industrialized. Move floor to floor across a grid-based map, managing scarce ammo and resources while deciding when to push deeper for a richer haul and when to extract back to camp. Between runs, process what you carried out into permanent upgrades to your loadout and your camp, then go further.

title: Clock Mayhem
description:
Clock Mayhem is a fast-paced platformer built around urgency, where players must run quickly and overcome obstacles and challenges to reach the end of each level before it is too late.

What makes the game unique is that each level is designed with its own twists and challenges. Every stage has its own time limit and collectibles, providing a dynamic experience.

You will start with Luni, but other characters can be unlocked after completing all cycles. Each character has their own abilities and their own set of completely different levels, providing a unique gameplay experience. To master the entire game and set new records, players must complete every cycle with every character.

Each level you reach will automatically become available in Practice Mode, where you can select and replay it, learn its patterns, and improve without penalty. This helps you prepare for each cycle, since every cycle must be completed in one go to master it.

title: Within The Experiments
description: A system-driven turn-based RPG bringing new strategy to the classic Wizardry-style formula. Cut in on enemy actions with the "Interrupt Timeline Battle" system. Lead a five-member party, strengthen your team through combat and item discovery, and explore the dungeon's depths.

title: My Brother Hacker
description: My Brother Hacker is a single-player hacking game set in 2036. Your brother has been missing for two weeks. He left a USB stick behind: an unfamiliar operating system, and an AI that starts teaching you how to break into networks.

title: Between Gods
description: Between Gods is a punishing action roguelite where your crusade is to slay every god. Master precise parries, battle relentless foes, discover powerful gear from shops and enemy drops, and grow stronger by spending skill points after each death.

title: C.A.G.E.
description: C.A.G.E. is a satirical first-person narrative adventure where your choices influence the story. Guided by an entity with questionable morals, you must navigate through corporate gaslighting and environmental oddities to complete your tasks. Your empathy is a glitch, compliance is your currency.

title: No Signal: Chornobyl
description: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.

title: I Hear the Forest
description: A slow-burn folk horror. You play as a forest ranger who finds himself surrounded by talking trees, flying witches' heads, and cursed dryads. You'll be very lucky if you make it out of the forest alive.

title: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
description: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

title: Hyperdrop
description: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

title: Spell Breakers
description: Build your Spell Deck, defeat your rivals, and aim for the top of the mysterious tournament, Spell Breakers! This is a new kind of auto-battle roguelike game where collecting over 300 spells is the key to victory!

title: Lilith
description: Every head is a world. Lilith is a folk-art puzzle-platformer set inside nesting dolls: climb into heads, hang characters on your tree to wear their skills, and descend through an İstanbul of graveyards, malls and rooftops, until you find the man in the shower.

title: Susuki Kaidan
description: A first-person survival horror set in the dying fields of Sengoku Japan. To reach Kyoto and escape the war, a lone survivor must cross endless fields of susuki grass while the White Ghost watches from within.

title: Panic 64
description: Panic Porcupine returns in a high-speed 3D platformer that blends classic run n' jump mechanics with racing elements!

title: Across Crime
description: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

title: Sin or Suffer
description: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.

title: Kimbap Factory
description: Automate the ultimate Korean kitchen. Route belts, watch ingredients transform, and physically assemble each kimbap roll step by step. Discover new recipes, fulfill requests, and expand your kitchen at your own pace. No pressure, no timers, just a satisfying and unique casual factory experience.

title: Cold Case
description: Enter the burned crime scene and restore 8 cases from the past. The crime scene photos and records have been charred black, but as a cold case investigator, your deduction and forensic skills can reveal what happened. Search by keyword, reconstruct the sequence of events, and uncover the truth.

title: Goblin God
description: In Goblin God, you rule a tribe of chaotic goblins! Build villages, defend against evil humans, and unleash divine powers to shape the world (or cause mayhem). Each island brings new challenges—will you lead your goblins to glory or just enjoy the chaos?

title: Cheeky Cheerhythm
description: "Wanna crush my pride? No way, you wimp!♡" Coach your proud student Iroha, designed by Asanagi, in this physical rhythm game! No matter your flawless timing, you'll get cheeky banter. Yet, your coaching works: her smooth Live2D animations react in real-time to your rhythm!

title: Girlfailure Art Club
description: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

title: Man I Just Wanna Live
description: Mia wakes up with a hangover and a dead body in her apartment. Unfortunately, the body has friends who are about to break in through the front door. From there, things only get worse. This "MSPaint-noir" VN with 16 endings is as stylish as it is relentless. Mia just wants to live! Well, who doesn’t?

title: Monster Girl Clinic
description: Welcome to Monster Girl Clinic. You arrive as a patient — but something here isn't adding up. Get to know the clinic's unusual staff, follow the clues, and uncover what's really going on, in a story-driven visual novel of mystery, romance, and monster girls.

title: Dice Crawler
description: At the bottom of the dungeon lies the rotting corpse of a dead god, festering and devouring the land above. Descend into the depths. Slay the monsters. Resurrect the god. Dice Crawler is a dice-based roguelite game.

title: Ladder Lad
description: In a world that has forgotten how to jump, one Lad must rise. Climb, wobble, and bounce your way to new heights in this challenging, 100% ladder-themed precision platformer.

title: Spirefall
description: The wars are fake. The grudges are real. A roguelite deckbuilder set in the taverns of Spirefall — win the Gauntlet, build your caravan, and conquer the greatest tables in the realm. One card at a time. Probably after questioning the stew.

title: Nursery Rhyme: Full HD Remaster
description: An all ages remaster of Nursery Rhyme with a new Kururu route, re-recorded and re-arranged OP/ED songs and movies.

title: The Money Man
description: A century ago, the wealthy fled to Mars. Earth is rotting, and the underworld owns New York. In a speakeasy backroom, you verify cash paid to a crime family, using tools and guides to spot counterfeits and expose liars. With someone you love on the line, there's no room for mistakes

title: Jay and Silent Bob's: Joint Venture
description: After Jay and Silent Bob sell you a bad dimebag, you help New Jersey’s legendary slackers take their operation from a rundown backyard to the best operation in the tri-state area in this gleefully obscene cozy farming adventure.

title: Häxeri
description: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!

title: Legend of Bakehime
description: A thrilling Japanese-style action game featuring Saya, a half-yokai princess who fires spiritual arrows from her bow, and Jubei, her kind-hearted retainer who wields a spear with mastery. Together, they stand against waves of terrifying yokai through the power of their bond!

title: Agro Tycoon
description: Grow a farming empire from a single plot of land. Agro Tycoon is an isometric pixel art management simulator where you're not just a farmer - you're the CEO of your own agricultural operation.

title: Ringwyrm
description: Ringwyrm is an immersive action horror game with survival elements. Explore a nonlinear interconnected world, meet a large cast of memorable characters, slay a huge cast of sickly monstrosities and avoid myriad diseases and ailments.

title: Balance: Umbilical Wake
description: Step into a fishermans recurring nightmare of living on a levitating platform that tilts with every move. Learn the worlds rules, solve its puzzles, catch fish, and inject them into your navel to wake up. But the nightmare keeps returning until your childs birth begins to reshape it.

title: American Navy Seals
description: Lead an elite Navy SEAL fireteam into a cinematic next-gen tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Command your squad, master authentic weapons, and fight through deadly global missions where every order, every shot, and every life matters.

title: Keyboard Smash
description:
Keyboard Smash is a fully voice acted story driven comedy game about running a small store while the characters around you are too stupid for their own good.
Help strange and random customers, travel to many bizarre locations, and make choices that turn the story upside down.

title: Steel Princess
description: A Souls‑like 3D action game starring a spirited princess. Defeat powerful foes scattered across the open field to unlock new skills, grow stronger, and keep pressing forward!

title: The Subminer
description: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

title: Dung Slinger
description: An action-packed physics platformer about being chained to a giant dung ball! Master a complex movement system to move, swing and launch yourself forward. Defeat enemies, overcome obstacles and regain your freedom in a game that blends traditional platforming with a tight physics system!

title: Black Well Devil
description: Ascend from the depths of hell in Black Well Devil, the stylish high-stakes platformer. Flick yourself into the air to reach higher heights, fall again and again, fight challenging bosses, and mayhaps fall in love.

title: Attack Only
description: Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.

title: Torizon Telecom
description: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

title: Carpet Cleaning Master
description: Clean filthy carpets until they look new again. Mind each one's rules, watch your water and power bills, and try not to think too hard about the company you work for. A cozy cleaning sim with something underneath.

title: Oath Eternal
description: A dark fantasy RPG inspired by the Metroidvania and Extraction genres.

title: 3Souls
description: 3 Souls is an isometric open-world adventure set in a vast archipelago. Control three brothers with unique playstyles, explore forgotten ruins, and gather resources to build your base. Uncover the secrets of the Althmerium in a grand journey where your choices shape the fate of a shattered world.

title: Pact of the Black Tide
description: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.

title: Hemlon the Grey
description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

title: I Shall Name the Dead
description: The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

title: Sticks and Stones
description: Post-apocalyptic survival simulator set after an asteroid (or asteroids) impact.

title: Deltarune: Chapter 6
description: An upcoming chapter for Deltarune.

title: Motorsport Manager 2
description: The world of motorsport returns in the next evolution of the ultimate motorsport management sim. Compete in multiple series, master deeper strategy than ever before, and lead your team to victory on and off the track. Build your racing legacy.

title: Elderfeast
description: Hunt. Carve. Cook. Elderfeast is a co-op action game where the monsters are the menu. Hunt Lovecraftian horrors across the galaxy and slice them apart for ingredients to make your next meal. The better you cook, the stronger you become, but there's always something more terrifying to hunt next.

title: MoonHack
description: MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world. The story segments are closely integrated with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized with vocal performances, and through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten.

title: Dhalman
description: Dhalman is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.

title: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
description: The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv Alternative" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

title: Cresata
description: Betrayed. Imprisoned. Left to die. Following a treacherous rebellion, Phaedon of Arsica is imprisoned and left for dead. Freed by a twist of fate, he now hunts down those who betrayed him and his homeland.

title: Insomnia Club
description: Insomnia Club is a dark, grounded emotional visual novel about early-adult confusion, social issues, intimacy, and self-identity. You play as a long-term insomniac employee whose life gradually slips out of control as reality tightens around you.

title: Mori
description: Experience lightning-fast combat as Mori, a grieving widow on a quest for revenge. Armed with nothing but a scythe and cloak, carve your way through countless foes, dismantle a criminal empire, and discover what it means to lose yourself.

title: Monji
description: A virtual companion that lives on your desktop and shares your clock. Monjis grow in real time, from an egg to a grown-up adult shaped by time-based events and small choices. Explore new places, loot parts and craft unique visual mods for your device to show your personality. MONji grows on you !

title: Shadows of Eldemir
description: Shadows of Eldemir is a retro-inspired, Victorian cosmic-horror, point-and-click adventure RPG, where a London schoolmaster travels to a remote Eastern European village searching for his missing fiancée, only to discover the archaeological expedition she joined may have disturbed something ancient.

title: Loaded Dice
description: Wager. Survive. Profit. Throw your friends around and bet against them to show who's faster, better, and smarter in Loaded Dice, a fast action-strategy party game.

title: Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Tifa & Outfit 2
Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Bosch & Outfit 2 & Outfit 3 (Yasmine, Arjun, Tifa, Bosch)
Broken Cycle
description: Broken Cycle is a dark-fantasy auto-battler RPG that lets you build a team of up to 5 mercenaries and send them to clear dungeons automatically — while you engineer their battle tactics, loot, craft and enchant their gear.

title: Herd
description:
Herd is a cute-but-competitive tactical card battler set in a magical musical world.
Build your deck, and face your rival in fast strategic duels where every card you play becomes part of a live musical performance.

But victory is not about reducing health points.

In Herd, you win by converting the Mélodus — adorable divine creatures who react to music, magic and momentum. Read your opponent, control the stage, trigger powerful synergies, and turn the crowd before your rival does.

title: Hunter White
description: White Hunt is a 2.5D open sandbox co-op hunting game. Every weapon features unique branching attack chains. Mix and match countless talismans to forge your exclusive combat style!

title: World Railway
description: In World Railway, a sim management game, you're a conductor reviving a rundown train. Produce and gather resources via loops, process and manage onboard. A new world unfolds with the wheel's rumble. On your journey, forge bonds and witness the seasons.

title: Might of Fate
description: A classic JRPG-style game about the conflict between magic and humanity in a medieval world. Experience Fate's story from his carefree childhood to becoming a powerful warrior. Assemble a party and master the combat stance system to change the fate of the world.

title: Eclipse
description: Eclipse is a new survival horror experience that combines modern horror with classic horror elements. Drawing inspiration from classic horror games, Eclipse delivers a new and fresh take on survival horror.

title: Echoes of Midnight
description: Bound. Dressed. Displayed. A serial killer's ritual has begun — and you're the centerpiece. Use silence as your weapon, solve the killer's twisted puzzle, and escape before midnight. Play solo, survive together in co-op, or become the hunter in versus mode.

title: Save Humanity.exe
description: A roguelike deckbuilder based around designing a microchip from a pile of junk circuits to out compute incoming viruses trying to crash your system. Combo hardware with software programs to chain multipliers that overflow your FLOP meter before the glitches overwhelm you.

title: Pikuniku 2
description: Absurd puzzle-exploration adventure Pikuniku 2 brings the whimsy! Wander, solve, and gossip your way through a weird and wonderful world where not everything is as happy as it seems. Protect the potato!

title: Xenoblade Genesis
description: A new beginning for the Xenoblade series is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton
description: Survive, Exorcise, Change the game JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON is a survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits and rival sorcerers, growing stronger throughout the match. Outscore your rivals and fight to be the last player standing victorious.

title: Sunset Survival: Miami
description: Gear up, get out, and survive the neon-soaked apocalypse. Sunset Survival: Miami is a top-down PvE extraction shooter. Raid a mutant-infested Miami for vital supplies, blast your way through enemy hordes, upgrade your base, and unlock powerful skills. Can you make it out alive?

title: Wardens of Avalon
description: Restore the former glory of a corrupt Camelot in Wardens of Avalon, an Action RPG set in a Dark Arthurian world. As a new member of the Twilight Knights, establish your fiefdom, explore, craft and gear up for thrilling adventures against the fallen Knights of the Round Table, alone or with friends.

title: Red Kiss
description: Dispatch a team of vampire spies through the tense and fractured streets of Cold War Berlin. Fulfill your darkest impulses as you tap into their powers, gain their trust, and manipulate your way through this (blood)thirsty Tactical Narrative RPG.

title: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
description: Magicians: The Devils Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

title: Senua
description: A Celtic warrior is trapped between life and death in a fractured vision of purgatory. In an action‑adventure set in the Hellblade universe, Senua fights to reach the afterlife and reunite with those she loved and lost, battling forces that threaten all she believes in.

title: Bad Magpie
description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

title: Brassfang
description: Explore a castle filled with monsters and sinister experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

title: Star Trek: Shadow Frontier
description: Star Trek: Shadow Frontier is a story-driven, action-adventure set in the expansive Star Trek universe. Step into the fractured mind of former Lieutenant Ro Laren (voiced by Michelle Forbes) as she seeks to rescue an old friend by embarking on a harrowing journey of survival and self-discovery.

title: Chosen Anyway: Card Game
description: Chosen Anyway is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder with permanent progression. Build your deck each run, face challenging bosses, and grow stronger as your cards scale with Ryn's RPG stats.

title: My Cannibal Family
description: You are the lurking terror in My Cannibal Family, a gloriously grotesque monster horror sim. Build a twisted theme park, then use traps and stealthy attacks to harvest guests within a deadly sandbox of your own creation!

title: Impermanence
description: A father. A condemned theatre. A son’s voice echoing from the beyond. Step into a narrative horror game about grief, obsession, and the act of holding on as a force older than grief pushes back.

title: Burn-9
description: A spy thriller where you’re not the spy. Safe behind your screen, guide the last survivor of an elite black-ops team in a desperate attempt to salvage a mission gone horribly wrong. Caught between military command and your agent, information is your greatest weapon.

title: Rubber Bird
description: Meet Rub the bird and help him answer the big question: why does he have arms? Jump, stretch, grab, throw, and mess up everything around you in this bite-sized physics-based platformer.

title: Waterful
description: A peaceful nature-builder where you dig riverbeds to guide water through tiny desert valleys. Grow a variety of plants and discover all the animals drawn to the new habitats. Complete quests and unlock new contraptions to transform the dry landscape into a lush oasis!

title: Hidden Folks 2
description: Search for hidden folks in interactive miniature landscapes. Scare some giraffes, ride a few rides, appreciate some art, and push around some astronauts. Wheeeeeeee!!!

title: Annexation
description: Annexation is a fast-paced real-time strategy game with old-school roots. Build bases, train armies, and outmaneuver your enemy to claim victory. Start by playing the campaign and then challenge yourself in arcade missions, which bring the intensity of multiplayer RTS into a single-player setting.

title: The Telwynium
description: A 90s fantasy adventure epic from the creator of The Drifter- It's your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

title: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
description: A text-driven noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in the text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects to solve the murder of fashion icon Margot Voss.

title: Sepak U: Sports Fighting Game
description: Smash-Like Volleyball - Fighting Game meets Volleyball and Football with 1-4 players, 21 characters, 21 arenas, with over 10 hours of solo/co-op content, minigames, and epic boss battles. Based on Sepak Takraw, a cultural Asian sport.

title: Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered
description: Step into the origins of the world’s deadliest assassin, faithfully remastered for modern platforms. Follow the evolution of Agent 47 from his creation to his most dangerous assignments across a world defined by deception, power, and consequence.

title: Ithaca
description: Ithaca is a narrative road-trip with RPG elements about environmental resistance. You play as Penelope, a young environmental rights lawyer, as she drives towards the most important decision she'll ever have to make.

title: Bub
description: A narrative adventure game about turning your memories into art while you still can. Made with slashes of ink and paint and thousands of cut paper pieces, Bub is a deeply personal, living, breathing game world.

title: N Plus Infinity Times Two
description: 5 fresh flavors of world-class online mayhem, from Friendship-Testing Co-op to Friendship-Ending Competitive, plus classic singleplayer. Run around with friends, lure enemies into opponents, make the ultimate sacrifice for teammates, and hunt each other with rockets. Couch-ready/Tournament-worthy.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance
description: Massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance has been announced!

title: Resident Evil Veronica
description: Claire Redfield returns to the forefront in this remake of the title originally released on the Dreamcast in 2000 and the following year on PlayStation 2. This new version preserves the essence of the original game while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics.

title: MKS: Model Kit Studio
description: A rich and relaxing model-building simulator. Enjoy the meditative flow, meet fellow builders, and unwind to a soothing soundtrack as you build, pose, paint, and display your collection.

title: The Book of Prosperity
description: A 2D Action RPG set in a surreal pixel-art world where ancient magic seeps through Hong Kong-inspired streets. Pulled into a parallel dimension ruled by the Circle, Cyrus must master rhythmic combat, rooftop parkour, and forbidden truths to uncover the cost of a world built on false prosperity.

title: The Omega Reach
description: Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe! The Omega Reach is a point-and-click museum simulator (and dungeon crawler) where you are a musical genius.

title: Cat Craft
description: A cozy first-person sim blending Gardening and Alchemy. Grow magical crops and mix ingredients to craft endless unique cats. Manage your Cat Café, find homes for your cats, and bring warmth, colors, and love back to the Gray world. From fluffy tails to quirky personalities, every cat is unique.

title: Bathory: Heritage of Blood
description: Play as Ursula Bathory, the vampire Princess, awakened from a centuries long slumber to claim her throne of blood in this Vampire Soulsvania inspired by Castlevania, Nosferatu and gothic victorian literature classics.

title: Orbital Drift
description: Explore drifting wrecks orbiting a dead planet. Master orbital mechanics. Fight zero gravity in space. Gather resources and build modules. Upgrade your ship to travel further. Uncover a civilization’s downfall. Are people on Earth ready to learn its history?

title: The Pines
description: A psychological horror RPG where every choice has consequences. After a failed case, former detective Edward Walker arrives at The Pines, a secluded retreat with therapists on site and the promise of peace. But beneath its carefully constructed calm, something is deeply wrong.

title: Slot Machine Gun
description: Slot Machine Gun is a roguelike deckbuilder shooter where you wield an ever changing weapon : The Slot Machine Gun! Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects to create game breaking synergies.

title: R.override
description: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a run-based mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

title: Heroes of the Underworld
