description: An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Underworld is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fantasy world, inspired by 90s games and comic books.

title: MegaGum
description: Play as Uja in this 3D bubble-punk platformer blending action and adventure. Jump, glide, fight, and walk on walls using your Gum-powered abilities. Outsmart the traps of the mysterious Mister Gum and climb floor by floor through a factory filled with secrets, puzzles, and surprises.

title: NCH: Chronos Rebirth
description: When the war between the Enhanced and ordinary humans shatters the future, turning back time becomes humanity's final gamble. As a life scientist navigating two timelines, you must decide: force genetic equality or embrace natural selection? No matter your choice, someone will pay the price.

title: Papaya Plaza
description:
Welcome Mayor, to Papaya Plaza! This old tourist town isn't what it used to be, it's up to you to rebuild, draw back the visitors (the Beeps!), and bring the community together again.

Papaya Plaza is a snackable slice of life game for you to get lost in. Decorate and improve the town as you see fit, to make a perfect little spot for visitors to wander and enjoy. These beeps aren't picky, they just want to discover the next best-kept-secret!

title: Ragnarok Console Project
description:
Ragnarok Console Project is a new RPG based on the world of Ragnarok, a legendary intellectual property enjoyed by over 100 million players worldwide.

Set in a familiar yet completely reimagined world, players will confront a collapsing reality and the hidden truths buried within it.

Choices and consequences. A journey from which there is no turning back.

title: Frame of Suffering
description: Master both man and machine to escape the Ancient Temple. Customize your Hero and a modifiable Combat Frame to slay hordes and gatekeepers. Scavenge tech, uncover the Temple's history, and evolve your build in this Sci-Fi ARPG Roguelite. You're a prisoner - freedom lies at the heart of the Temple.

title: Mama
description:
An emotional narrative point-and-click about a daughter caring for her mother as dementia reshapes their bond. Explore heartfelt conversations, fragmented memories, and story-driven puzzles on a journey of caregiving and learning to let go.

Love is heavy. Care is relentless. Watching someone you love fade is a quiet, piercing heartbreak you can’t prepare for. In this game, you step into the shoes of a daughter, moving through a world shaped by dementia - not to solve it, not to fix it, but to live it, feel it, and carry it alongside the one you love. Every gesture, every pause, every choice matters.

Gameplay isn’t a distraction - it is the story. Simple, deliberate interactions and inventive puzzles put you inside moments of tenderness, confusion, and heartbreak. Seven chapters guide you through caregiving’s emotional terrain: the exhausting patience, the fragile joys, and the quiet sorrow of learning when to hold on - and when to let go.

Dementia is at the heart of the experience, shaping every conversation, memory, and interaction. Each day reveals shifting moods and fractured recollections, blurring the line between truth and misremembering. As the mother’s world becomes more fragile and uncertain, the gameplay mirrors her fading clarity — guiding you through moments of confusion, tenderness, and the quiet heartbreak of watching someone slip away.

title: Everything Is Gun!
description: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?

title: Some Puzzles
description: A surreal, FMV puzzle adventure. "It's got some puzzles."

title: Lock In
description: An escape-the-room puzzle game. Solve locks to unlock locks. Unlock locks to unlock more locks. Lock in.

title: Feed the Giants
description: You are a giant guiding a group of lost children through a hostile world. Help them… or sacrifice them to entertain your kind, who watch the spectacle from above. Some want to see them thrive, others crave their suffering. Every choice has its price.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
description:
Songs of the Past is a brand-new full-fledged expansion to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, one of the most acclaimed role-playing games of all time.

Created in partnership with Fool’s Theory, a team comprising veteran The Witcher 3 developers, players can once again take on the role of Geralt of Rivia and embark on a brand-new adventure before heading out on the Path as Ciri in the upcoming The Witcher 4.

title: Gambit
description: Chess game about beating strongest chess engine, but in roguelike style

title: Full Belly Breakout
description: Navigate the hidden dangers lurking within a wide variety of dishes, savor every bite, fill your stomach, and escape from a terrifying cell. An overwhelming dining experience where eyeballs crawl out of plain rice, sharks burst from soup, and entire universes unfold upon your plate.

title: Banquet of Nausea
description: Banquet of Nausea is a dark fantasy RPG made in RPGMaker. You will play as Liya — a girl on an epic quest to find her lost kin. Explore sacred ruins, purge festering abominations, and forge bonds with survivors whose fates lie in your hands.

title: Hyperspin
description: Spin to win!

title: Own Time Own Target
description: Own Time Own Target drops two players into a divided battlefield in a pure 2D 1v1 where reading the environment is just as important as outgunning your opponent. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Friendships not guaranteed.

title: Nexus Code
description: NEXUS CODE is a 3D programming battle game that reimagines the excitement of the "hobby anime" and "competitive toys" that captivated many children in the 90s and 2000s, using modern programming elements. Build your own unique character and challenge rivals with logical thinking as your weapon.

title: Under a Groove
description: 'Under A Groove' is a rhythm game that's fun just to watch, even if you're only playing the music video. A stylish rhythm action game where visuals and music sync perfectly—simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.

title: The Pactmaker
description: You are a professor who forged pacts with otherworldly entities to save your daughter. Dive into the memories of others, alter reality, and use your new supernatural abilities to uncover the truth in this dark point-and-click thriller.

title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 3
description: The speedy and stylish action of the Luminous Avenger series is back! Our hero Copen must use his new "Divide Edge" energy swords to protect his home from otherworldly invaders! His trusty partner Lola is there to support him with evolutionary new modes!

title: Nightmare Journey 1135
description: A horror adventure through wandering nightmares “The escape game is over.”

title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster
description: Play a sneaky & brutal Skaven Assassin in this new, refreshing but gritty take on the 2D Action platformer genre.

title: Falling Apart
description: Falling Apart is a disturbing point-and-click puzzle adventure about a man descending into his own fractured mind through hypnosis.

title: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
description: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

title: Depth-Bound
description: A physics-based underwater 2D platformer. Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always more deeply. Photograph strange creatures and follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.

title: Kint
description:
Kint is a modern version of the classic MUD RPGs. Set in the fictional world of Seram, players are researchers tasked with exploring and learning all they can about the world and it's mysterious kilns.

Players collect lore fragments, which often contradict which each other and the established canon and must submit and vote what should be marked as the truth each week.

title: Gigantic Maidestruction
description: A giant maid wreaks havoc on the city under the pretext of defeating enemies! Gigantic Destruction Action Game!

title: Starshard Brigands
description: Starshard Brigands is a first-person dungeon crawler with grid-based movement, where shifting loyalties and hard choices shape your fate. As a nameless mercenary in a fractured world, decide where you stand—or stand alone.

title: DeadStuck
description: Take on the role of a sinner fighting for absolution against hordes of the damned. Inspired by arcade light gun shooters and boomer shooters, use your quick reflexes tools of divine condemnation to come out victorious!

title: Disciple
description: Disciple is an eldritch horror pachinko roguelite. Launch your disc into the Abyss, shatter crystals for their essence, and wield the artefacts of a forgotten god. Harvest enough essence and you are reborn to descend again. Fail, and the Abyss devours you too.

title: The Talos Principle III
description: The Talos Principle 3 is the last chapter of the thought-provoking first-person puzzle series, taking you on a cosmic journey across more than a dozen worlds and testing your mind with all-new challenges.

title: Noir Bloom
description: Noir Bloom is a high-octane 2D Gun-Fu action game, where adrenaline-fueled gunfights and skull-crushing close combat collide in a neo-noir rhapsody. Embark on a deadly rampage to honor the vow—strike, disarm, and turn foes into weapons. Every move is a calculated ballet of bullets and blood.

title: The Lost Froglins
description: What if Vampire Survivors was a platformer? 100 lost baby froglins are trapped in a cave. Every one you save joins your swarm and fights for you. One is cute. Ten is trouble. A hundred is unstoppable. Die, upgrade, go again. A roguelite side-scroller.

title: Midnight Train: New Moon
description: A 2D exploration-based horror adventure game set in a creepy train and mysterious buildings.

title: Iron Bramble
description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

title: Up ' N ' Up: Mountain Express
description:
Deliver mail up the side of a mountain upgrading your 4WD as you go.
Like an arcade Mudrunners with a roguelike twist.

title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Rageborn
description: Set in the World of Darkness, Rageborn sees Taylor rise as a pack leader to become Gaia’s fiercest warrior. Master three forms of the Garou, explore the wilds of Alaska, and confront the Wyrm in this visceral action-adventure metroidvania.

title: Dracula: The Disciple
description: To cheat death, you must uncover the secrets hidden within Count Draculas castle. Only by mastering the occult arts and solving mystical puzzles can you save yourself. Eternal life comes at a price!

title: War Alert
description: As the frontline crawls through ruins and smoke, you command infantry, armor, and air support to shape the chaos. Capture points, break lines, encircle and counter-encircle. With no pay-to-win, only clear strategy and teamwork earns victory.

title: Blue Detective: A Hotel in Scarlet
description: As a gothic detective, you solve mysteries with your colorful sidekick. Everyone you meet in this bizarre world has a peculiar disease. A unique talent, or a mere curse? You must get to the bottom of it all. Investigate murders, search for clues and complete the puzzle.

title: Red Rising
description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

title: SandEEE
description: Write code for an alternate universe in SandEEE, just keep in mind "EEE sees all".

title: Trivals
description: A multiplayer sport where the goal adapts to stop you. No aim assist. No randomness. Just ball physics, hero abilities, and a target that gets harder to break the closer you get to winning.

title: Lunar Pulse
description: That night, thirteen witches devour each other. "Lunar Pulse" is a single-player roguelite card game. Under eternal moonlight, a ritual for life and death unfolds. Play simultaneously with hands revealed. One move invites instant death—soulslike tension in every card battle.

title: Casse-Croute Deckbuilder
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cook your strategy. As a Cook, manage your Hero’s Appetite and Cholesterol, and build powerful combos with food cards and kitchen tools. Every run serves a fresh tactical challenge.

title: Knuckle Paradise
description: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

title: Self-Replication: Destruction
description: A third-person shooter set in a crumbling megastructure. Fight drones, explore its sectors, and survive in a system that has spiraled out of control.

title: Victor's Video Vault
description: It's 1995. The video store is alive. When the last customer leaves, the final rental rewrites reality.

title: Tambourine
description: A priestess is hired to exorcize an apartment building with a Tambourine. Parry and torment ghosts in this first-person survival horror as you make your way up the building. Find the mementos that will allow you to complete the exorcism.

title: Bloodmoored
description: Bloodmoored is a first-person psychological horror. Revive a derelict factory by restarting its machinery. The spirits here are unpredictable: one moment they hunt you, the next they are your only key to salvation. Uncover their past to understand their motives and escape this trap alive

title: Into the Dust
description: Top-down tactical co-op extraction shooter. Up to four players scavenge, fight, and rebuild in the harsh, post-apocalyptic wastelands of Dust Bowl America.

title: Killing Baby Hitler
description: Stop fascism in the cradle. Travel through time and hunt down history’s most evil infant in this satirical old-school FPS.

title: Justice Project
description: Manage your very own operational courthouse, show your architectural talent, with every detail in your control. Let your management prowess show, schedule cases and trials alongside the ever present pressures of profit and reputation.

title: Abyss of Kings
description: Explore the remnants of an underground civilization and battle sentient chess pieces. Discover magical rings and use them to create your own spells. Meet the last inhabitants of a dead kingdom and escape the Abyss.

title: Pegote
description:
Pegote is inspired by Guerra (war), a simple card game many of us grew up playing with a Spanish deck.

It’s a game of chance and comparison. Flip a card, higher wins. Easy to learn, easy to play anywhere. We wanted to build on that familiar foundation, adding layers, decisions, and a bit of chaos :)

title: A Vessel of Frustration
description: You return to your hometown but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you are not here for them. You are here for her. Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world.

title: Tobari and the Vampire Alchemist
description: Guide the protagonist through the maps. Deep in the forest, an alchemist hides a monster, Tobari. Driven by hidden motives that outweigh the danger, the alchemist suffers from an illness. Beside them, the monster finds its heart torn by strange, conflicting emotions...

title: Mayfly
description: Mayfly is a story-rich, quiet horror set aboard a narrowboat in Northern England. A short psychological horror experience focused on exploration, story and atmosphere. Search a detailed, highly explorable narrowboat setting that evolves as the mystery unfolds. Uncover clues and memories amidst unsettling shifts in the environment around you. Solve puzzles to guide Caroline on her journey to be reunited with her husband Robert.

title: Witch the Showdown
description: A high-difficulty action game combining parry mechanics and deck-building. Fight your way through and aim to become the champion of the tournament.

title: False Echo
description: Inspired by Papers, Please, False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Atlantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

title: It Breathes
description: First-person VHS horror game set in an abandoned Hungarian hospital. Hide, fight, or flee while working towards your only goal: to escape.

title: Dungeon4X
description: Dungeon4X is a new type of game that combines 3D dungeon RPG with 4X strategy. As the guild master of an adventurer's guild, you will lead the construction of farms and workshops, build a financial base by selling products, and embark on a grand adventure to obtain the ultimate artifact!

title: Summer Snow.
description: Escape the endless midsummer in this time-loop mystery visual novel. Find the "exit key," solve the cryptic MAZE app's missions, and reach the future with your childhood friends! A coming-of-age drama with stunning visuals, a 300k-character voiced script, diverse puzzle mechanics, and no bad ends.

title: Crop
description: A gritty farming thriller where your safety depends on the yield. Bound to a dying farm, you must dig, plant, irrigate, and cut your way through the decay. Uncover buried secrets, both in the soil and quietly brewing within the village. The only way out is through the harvest.

title: The End of the World Club
description: A cute coming-of-age boys' love (BL/yaoi) visual novel set in 2012 about a group of high school students who start a club to prepare for the end of the world.

title: Liquid Lungs
description: Liquid Lungs is a high-speed FPS blending fluid parkour with intense combat. Inspired by free-running action games and fast-paced shooters, it delivers a seamless mix of movement and marksmanship in a dystopian world. Run, jump, and fight in a nonstop adrenaline rush where every motion counts.

title: Settle
description: A cozy puzzle about decor and history. Explore different eras by arranging authentic items from diverse cultures. Restore harmony to interiors of the past and enjoy the meditative flow.

title: Vaska
description: Meet Vaska — a cat lost in a strange and dangerous forest... Move quietly, hide, solve puzzles, and find your way home!

title: Kazoku Gokko
description: A new short work related to Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi wo Suru ⁂ and bundled with it.

title: Mahou Shoujo wo Wasurenai
description: A new short work related to Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi wo Suru ⁂ and bundled with it.

title: Kakegae no Nai Kimi he
description: A remake of Boku dake ga Shitteiru, the sequel to Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi o Suru, bundled in with its remake.

title: Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi wo Suru Asterism
description: A paid remake of Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi o Suru with enhanced illustrations and scenarios, with new sub-characters appearing.

title: Witherheart
description: Witherheart is a turn-based roguelike deck-building game with grid-based combat. Build your deck, reposition on the battlefield, and make tactical decisions where every card and every step can turn the tide of a fight.

title: Artificial Detective
description: Artificial Detective is a third-person action-adventure where you step into the shoes of a robodetective in a dystopian city overrun by rogue robots. Lead your underdog team of a military robodog and a human girl, as you fight, hack, and outsmart deadly machines to uncover why humans are gone.

title: Moosa: Dirty Fate
description:
MOOSA: Dirty Fate is a dark action game inspired by Korean history. "MOOSA" meaning is a person who has mastered martial arts and works in that field.

MOOSA: Dirty Fate is an action game based on the story of MOOSAs' revenge, responsibility, and ambition, centered on 17th-century Korea.

Face terrifying monsters, uncover the truth behind a cursed fate, and fight to save your people.

title: Wired Tokyo
description:
— Dive into Tokyo. Dive into the past. —
WIRED TOKYO is a vertical 3D action game where you climb toward the vast skies above Tokyo.
To unlock new abilities, you may have to deliberately “dive” from above.
A climbing game where falling has meaning — that’s WIRED TOKYO.

title: Gabby's Odyssey
description: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

title: The Fancy Pants Adventures Online
description: Relive the classic Fancy Pants Adventures with your friends in an epic online arcade. Play through the story, mess around in platforming sandboxes, challenge each other to some friendly PvP, or tour through a round of Fancy Golf together.

title: Storm The House Collection
description: Defend your base, upgrade your arsenal, and survive the siege! The iconic Storm the House trilogy of fixed-position shooters returns from the golden age of Flash, now preserved and better than ever.

title: Murderplanet
description: Fight to the death in the arena-based action roguelike game show, Murderplanet. Craft a build of ridiculous and broken synergies to weave and cleave through hordes of enemies. Survive each wave, stake out Capture Points, earn heaps of cash and further customize your runs for maximum arcade chaos.

title: Hoarder
description: Clean. Possess. Control. Hoarder begins as a mundane cleaning simulator which spirals into a submerged nightmare. Pilot a submarine, recover what shouldn’t be found, and uncover the secrets of your new home by night.

title: Crewcial
description: Join the craziest repair company in the space-time continuum! In this 2D party game, teamwork is everything: fix machines, manage heat and pressure, toss tools around, and climb the leaderboard, without losing your friendship!

title: Aware
description: You will play a detective and go back to winter Peking more than seventy years ago. On the eve of the peaceful liberation of Peking, you will feel the cold, nothingness, exploration, pursuit, drama and gunshots in the process of searching for missing persons.

title: Ismene
description: The story of Ismene, floating through space with her trusted robot companion, trying to figure out where she is going, and where she came from.

title: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
description: You are a hunter of men, and your quarry is numerous, armed, and afraid. Bind and break them. This is a first-person immersive sim with tightly interconnected environments, sleek and sadistic melee combat, and over a hundred cosmetics to unlock.

title: Sprkls.exe
description: sprkls.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven adventure that unfolds entirely on your desktop.

title: Everhood Hunters
description: Everhood's musical combat a la Roguelite! ⚔️ Easy to play but hard to master. Join up with a friend in co-op to conquer the spiraling madness straight from the minds of Everhood's creators.

title: Pokémon Winds
description: Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves are upcoming role-playing video games developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo and The Pokémon Company for the Nintendo Switch 2. Announced on 27 February 2026, on the franchise's 30th anniversary, they are the first installments in the tenth generation of the Pokémon video game series and the first to be exclusively available on the Switch 2. They are set to release in 2027.

title: Pokémon Waves
description: Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves are upcoming role-playing video games developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo and The Pokémon Company for the Nintendo Switch 2. Announced on 27 February 2026, on the franchise's 30th anniversary, they are the first installments in the tenth generation of the Pokémon video game series and the first to be exclusively available on the Switch 2. They are set to release in 2027.

title: Money Under the Bed
description: You complained to a strange roadside statue about being broke—and the next day, a jar of money appeared under your bed. How do you plan to spend this windfall? Of course, you’re free to squander every cent... as long as you can survive until tomorrow.

title: Flesh & Wire
description: Flesh & Wire is a first-person shooter that delves into the psychological horror roots of the POSTAL series. Venture into this twisted reality as Angel, a hapless victim suddenly swept up in a fever dream of conspiracy and blood as she seeks answers and vengeance against the crazed gunman who changed her life forever.

title: Beware of the Cartographer!
description:
A young cartographer is sent out by his hierarchy into the rural land of his childhood to redraw a frontier: he will gradually discover that this place, which for him was just a set of inky territories, is actually steeped in stories, inhabited by people who have no idea what's going on around them and whose relationship to space is radically different...
The player embodies a land surveyor who explores a rural territory and must make choices that will have an impact on diplomacy, but also on the local population. The game combines visual novel phases and observational puzzles — the two aspects nourishing each other to modify the plot of an interactive story.

title: Sisters of Solitude
description: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.

title: Scorched Earth
description: Scorched Earth is a chunky PS2 mecha-action game with massive amounts of customization, where you play as a mercenary taking on dirty jobs across a planetary war.

title: Burdenfall
description: Burdenfall is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder about personal growth and inner struggle. Ascend a mysterious castle with your shapeshifting companion, whose transformations shape and evolve your deck. Survive the climb and uncover the truth behind the Weeping Crown’s message.

title: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do
description: When you tell your girlfriend you want to break up, she refuses to accept it. Is your resolve strong enough to become single or will you cave and stay together? A 30-minute visual novel - Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

title: Rev. Noir
description: Drawn together by chance, Asch and Finé set out to stop the Lightfall, a calamity that brings death to all it touches. As their journey to save the world unfolds, they uncover a fate neither expected... Defy cruel fate in the all-new RPG, Rev. NOiR.

title: Yakoh: Shinobi Ops
description: Four Shinobi lurking in the darkness. Silent as shadows, racing through the night. To complete their deadly mission, they master their arts—hiding, sparing lives, deceiving—as they venture toward either death or salvation. Evade the relentless pursuit of immortal Hunters, and only by returning alive will their mission be fulfilled.

title: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
description: In Kena: Scars of Kosmora, Kena is older and renowned as a Spirit Guide. In hopes of finding answers to the affliction she has endured all her life, Kena travels to the mysterious island of Kosmora. Home to distinct cultures and regions, Kosmora is full of buried secrets from a tragic past.

title: Nova Assault
description:
Extraction-based first-person shooter designed to deliver a realistic, immersive experience. With its own economy and internal progression system, Nova Assault challenges you with thrilling trials and missions in diverse, highly detailed environments.

Prepare for intense firefights, survival-driven strategies, and explore a world teeming with opportunities, dangers, and precious resources.

title: Labyren
description: Labyren is a medieval-themed Tower Defense game centered on multi-waypoint mazing and vision. While traversing through the campaign, discover countless unique strategies building with your ever-expanding arsenal and unravel the story underneath!

title: Fortune and Glory
description: Fortune & Glory is a text-parser action RPG about leaving home to become a hero! Decide who you are as you explore an ailing world in a detailed retro-inspired style. Gain help from your personalities and their internal dialogue to solve puzzles and fight monsters in a realtime battle system.

title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Players control Kaatri, a veteran warrior who forms a pact with an otherworldly entity to wield dark magic against formidable foes. The game focuses on open-world exploration, visceral combat blending melee and spell-casting, and the thematic cost of power.

title: Codex Lost 2
description: Magic and intrigue abound in this gripping dark fantasy RPG, with atmospheric exploration that will beguile even the most avid fans of the genre. Wield a diverse array of weapons and spells as you step forth into a world of intoxicating mystery to face the many challenges lurking within.

title: Idle Chibi Knight
description: Chibi Knight returns in an idle dungeon crawler! Fighting and exploration happen automatically while you cast spells, acquire loot, unlock new skills, level up your attributes, and push deeper. Replay as multiple classes in this casual, incremental RPG.

title: Amigo: The Broken Loop
description: AMIGO is a first-person narrative-driven psychological thriller that follows a woman, Julien, after the death of her friend. As she investigates the mysterious Focus on Dream corporation, Julien uncovers a distorted world of memories, puzzles, and secrets – where nothing is quite what it seems.

title: Mimi's Restaurant helper
description: 2000's anime style restaurant game meets Wario ware , a game about making dishes and multitasking but with cute 2D art and beautiful bossanova music, Chaotic meets Cozy

title: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse 3
description:
Step into a brand-new future Dragon ball universe filled with unique, original characters brought to life by Akira Toriyama, the original author of Dragon Ball. In Age 1000, journey through developed and vibrant West City. Explore the bustling city, encounter characters, and uncover exciting new stories.
Take your place in the story and experience what awaits in West City.
Guided into the ranks of the Great Saiyan Squad, you’ll fight alongside allies as events there begin to take shape.

title: Panline
description: Welcome to post-scarcity! But you’re not on the list. Deliver to make a living off-grid while Panline, the abundance engine that keeps the city endlessly supplied, begins to change. Earn currency, favors, kit upgrades and work the runner scene to unlock new contacts and fixers.

title: Pilot 6174: Orbital Survival
description: Navigate star systems using real orbital mechanics. Pilot a cockpit with controls inspired by the Apollo command module. Manage heat, energy, and trajectory.

title: Bel's Fanfare
description: Bel's Fanfare is an RPG with rich deep exploration and expressive combat. You play as Bel, the new aura cleaner of the once-luxurious vessel The Witch of the Sea.

title: Ork
description: One day, a mighty quake shakes the land — Colors fade away, this wasn't planned! “This is bad!” cry five odd friends in stride, They gather, rise, and run side by side. Use their skills, push through each stage, Reach the goal in a 2D side-scrolling rage!

title: Born from the Soil
description: Conquer the apocalypse using gritty dirt bikes and explosive ordnances in Born from the Soil, a blend of classic turn-based tactics, modern gameplay polish, and 16-bit retro charm.

title: Dawnrazor
description: Step into the decaying world of Kagenovia in Dawnrazor, a story-driven 8-bit action adventure! Take control of Zedekiah, a betrayed knight reborn through parasitic vampirism, as he fights through blood-soaked ruins and biomechanical horrors.

title: Wandersky
description: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

title: Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter
description:
Rogue machines, mutant insects, and jazz echoing through deep space
A stylish blend of survival horror and noir detective mystery wrapped in a decopunk aesthetic. Beautifully unsettling.

title: Waffles' Cranked Stories
description: Waffles' Cranked Stories is a selection of mini-games set in the same universe as Inspector Waffles, originally released exclusively on the Playdate console. This time, follow the adventures of Chance and Spike and discover new stories that expand on the previous ones!

title: Project M
description: Survive as a vessel, intervene as a god. You play as the mysterious Entity, guiding the actions of a lone traveler who has arrived in the desolate ghost town. Use your powers to manipulate the environment and prevent your puppet from descending into the depths of madness.

title: Gachiakuta: Breakout
description: Based on the hit TV anime, GACHIAKUTA: BREAKOUT is a survival action RPG featuring intense melee combat and fast-paced battles. Build your team and master dynamic mechanics to defeat powerful foes. Explore the world of Gachiakuta in striking cartoon-style visuals.

title: Radiant Sky
description: You and a group of adventurers must travel the world and unite the factions of weather spirits to stop constant natural disasters and stop an inevitable world ending catastrophe once the sky turns "radiant".

title: Ontos
description: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

title: No Law
description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

title: Decrepit
description: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.

title: The Free Shepherd
description: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

title: From Ruins
description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

title: UN:Me
description: UN:Me is an adventure game where you guide a girl harboring multiple souls within her body through an unsettling mental labyrinth, engaging in dialogue with each soul while making the harrowing choice of which to keep and which to erase in your escape attempt.

title: Go Phish
description: Go Fish or go homeless. In this rogue-ish debt-builder, pay your rent by phishing a target in a supercharged version of the classic card game. Crack your victims password in a dynamic dialogue system, then use your loadout of unlockable suits and items to hack their PC and drain their savings.

title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
description: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

title: Gate Guard Simulator
description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

title: Road to Jukai
description: Drive through Japan’s suicide ring in your night-shift taxi. Pick up strange passengers, fulfill their unsettling requests and follow the silent road as their stories make each ride darker than the last.

title: Inkblood
description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

title: Epoch Reset
description: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.

title: Incoherence: Dark Rooms
description: Dark Rooms is a survival horror room-drafting game set in a looping nightmare. Expand the map by placing rooms at the cost of stability. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, manage limited resources, and unlock new rooms and upgrades. Every run is a new descent into darkness.

title: Cardaver
description: Cardaver is a tower defense, deckbuilder, with roguelike looping gameplay. Using a wide variety of monsters and spells to defend each lane, help the Dragon Queen protect her Castle Kingdom against an army of fantasy do-gooders and tyrannical princesses.

title: End of Eden
description: End of Eden is an open world RPG where you arrive unwanted on a cursed island and must earn every inch. Master tight melee, archery and magic. Join a faction, grow deep talents, craft gear, and explore a living world with real routines, tough bosses and meaningful quests.

title: All Adrift
description: Whether its end is dark or bright, create a religion for a fabricated god and perform surgery on the history of the universe. Strive to understand all things in the universe that mere humans cannot know. For now, survive like that.

title: Mayak
description: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

title: Tutankhamun: Builders of the Eternal
description: A 3D city-builder where you farm the Nile, worship powerful gods, train armies, trade with distant regions, and construct monumental works worthy of ancient Egypt.

title: King's Courier
description: King’s Courier is a free roam, party-based RPG. Carry out perilous quests for the King while exploring dungeons, enchanted forests, deadly swamps, and monster-filled caves. Build your party, learn magic, battle in real-time or turn-based, solve puzzles, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets.

title: Cocoboy
description: Rediscover the lost ‘80s platformer COCOBOY in an alternate 2005! Hack a forgotten game with bizarre mods, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour the forums of a budding fandom for clues to deeply puzzling secrets.

title: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

title: Rhythm Doggo
description: You wanted to play a video game and just got transformed into a dog! Rhythm Doggo is a classic platform adventure where you play as a dog and make music on the way. Can you go back to your human form?

title: Abelina
description: Explore a surreal wilderness by platforming and use timing based hits to gather resources. Break open branching paths to get to the other side of a giant world, talk to it's strange inhabitants, and try to understand the nature of this world.

title: Soverain: An Eternal Legend
description: Eternal Legend is a turn-based tactical RPG that blends political drama and family destiny. Build your army, forge bonds, and wage epic pixel art battles in a world torn apart.

title: Spar Kart
description: Spar Kart is a free-to-play racing fighting game that combines casual racing gameplay with competitive fighting game mechanics. The game offers a unique blend of casual fun with friends and intricate combat that's both accessible to newcomers and deep enough for competitive players.

title: Donut Panic
description: Order up! Donut Panic is an anomaly horror game with a cooking sim twist. Take customer orders. Prepare and serve up delicious donuts. But when the hallucinations appear, run for your life. Your panic room is there for a reason...

title: Chill Planet
description: On this planet destined to perish, let's embark on the ultimate chill journey. This deck-building adventure game depicts girls traveling leisurely toward Hokkaido in a world doomed to destruction by an impending meteor strike.

title: Elestrals Awakened
description:
In a world shaped by Gods and Titans, the elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. As darkness stirs and conflict brews among the realms, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise.

Elestrals Awakened is 2.5D single-player action-adventure, monster tamer RPG video game that puts you at the center of the Elestrals Universe. Step into the role of a Caster, forge a bond with a Spirit companion, and explore the elemental lands as tensions rise and ancient powers awaken!

title: Begraved
description: A cosy & dark first-person co-op dungeon crawler where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due.

title: Misdecayed
description: An adventure RPG about life, death, rebirth, and robots.

title: Project Tal
description: An open-world action Korean mythology RPG. Players will explore a detailed and in-depth world across a single-player adventure inspired by ancient folklore that reimagines Korea’s traditional Tal masks. Engage with an array of threats from massive monsters to formidable swordsmen, making use of enemy weak points, counterattacks, unique abilities, and more.

title: Your Forever Friend
description: Your Forever Friend is the solution to never feeling alone again! Play video games, listen to music together, reminisce about buried memories... And there's absolutely nothing wrong with it. NOTHING ! <3

title: Prospice
description: Prospice blends tense driving and atmospheric horror as you haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain hungers and every road bears the scars of the past.

title: Little Crossroads
description: Escape the rush of your other life in this multiplayer Cozy RPG. Advance in a deep progression of skills like Fishing, Mining, and Bug Catching. Unlock cute and cool cosmetics to customize your character. Experience the "cozy chaos" of random events. All solo or with friends. Welcome home!

title: Pine Creek
description: A weekend getaway to Pine Creek in '86 turns into a nightmare when your wife vanishes as strange lights appear in the sky. Solve puzzles, hide from the grays, save Sarah and survive the night in this first-person stealth survival horror. The truth is darker than you think.

title: Bearskull 2
description: A vast open world, ruthless Vikings, powerful bosses, and an epic co-op mode – rise to the challenge!

title: Space Hood
description: Defend your outpost in this tower defense with a raiding twist. Battle the ruthless Nova Roma Corporation as you build, loot, and survive relentless assaults.

title: Brass & Bramble
description: Brass & Bramble is a narrative deck-builder set in a steampunk Victorian age where myth and empire collide. As Avalon’s Envoy, battle the brass-forged Empire, uncover forgotten roots of myth, and journey from Ireland to Egypt, Japan, and beyond in story-driven expeditions.

title: Misha
description: Play as a hacker backing up Misha—whose brain has been transplanted into a sexyroid—as you face off against all threats that stand in your way in this cyberpunk FPS.

title: Dance with the Moon
description: A boy who hates the night meets a vampire girl who loves it. As they steal blood packs and help those in need under the cover of darkness, the two gradually fall in love. A multi-ending visual novel that gently illuminates the lives of those lost in the night and offers comfort to the lonely.

title: Itachi: Haunted Abodes - Wandering Through 2000s Tokyo Culture
description: Itachi: Hunted Abodes is a paranormal suspense adventure that has you wandering through 2000s Tokyo's subculture scenes!

title: No Walls in Heaven
description: No Walls In Heaven is a first-person exploration platformer about losing yourself in the hostile vastness of the cosmos. Grapple, leap, and fight your way through the towering concrete and metal landscapes of a lost megastructure that seems to disobey all laws of physics and reality.

title: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
description: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

title: Wild Chorus
description: An adventure game, but you play musical instruments instead of swinging swords. Gather adorable Sound Sprites, cut through the looming Silence, and rebuild the soundtrack of this hand-illustrated world in whatever way you see fit. No musical ability required!

title: Living Hell
description: A co-op horror where you must retrieve specimens before sunrise, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations.

title: Appa
description: Appa is a narrative driven simultaneous card game about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. You play as Varun witnessing surreal nightmares and manifestations of his deceased father and playing a card game with him.

title: The Lift
description: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

title: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift
description: Fantasy Point & Click Horror Drama: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you seek the truth of magic’s birth, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.

title: Curse of Dominion
description: Crowned for saving the king, you wield the coveted Blessing of Dominion. Command tense tactical battles, deepen companion Loyalty, evade those who would kill for your power, and watch a secret moral scale quietly reshape Elvorith’s fate.

title: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
description: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

title: Ultrasound
description: A sci-fi horror 3D point&click game. Use an ultrasound machine to diagnose and do surgery on a grotesque infection spreading aboard a space freighter. Craft meds, upgrade your machine, find new surgical tools, and restore ship systems before you collide with a star. Soon, something will be born.

title: Midnight Souls
description: Explore the mysteries of the small town of Camomile Peaks! Date the girl of your dreams, fight your enemies, and make socially acceptable friends in this dark humor-flavored RPG. And keep your cat, Charlie, out of trouble!

title: Evilbane
description: Evilbane is a dynamic and action-packed strategy-based experience that you can tackle solo or with friends. Switch freely between ranged and melee weapons, and customize your skills for every situation to create your own unique warrior. Your choices and teamwork will determine your victory!

title: Eternity
description:
An unforgettable journey of discovery, hope, and survival, as you strive to unlock the secrets of the universe and pave the way for humanity's destiny.

By intertwining Exploration, Adaptive Gameplay, and Survival, ETERNITY offers a rich and immersive experience where you’re guiding humanity’s last fleet through a procedurally generated galaxy, and your “empire” is a moving city of ships. Every vessel is both a building and a lifeline. You’ll expand by salvaging and refitting new ships, exploit resources across systems, and face moral and political decisions that can shape the fleet’s future.
